title: NotificationsMessageFailedPayload
description: Payload of `notifications.message.failed` version 1: a message was given up, refused by its channel's provider or still undeliverable after the retries at 1, 5 and 30 minutes. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner the message is about, else `null`. Never the number, the address or the words; the delivery log has the rest. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

message_id.description: The message, in the delivery log.

template.description: The template it was composed with.

event.description: The event type it told of.

order_id.description: The order it was about, when one.

location_id.description: The Location it was about, when one.

attempts.description: How many times it was tried.

reason.description: Why it failed, with the provider's own words when it refused.
examples: the provider refused the number as invalid
